page.overview:
Who is Udo Barnet?

Udo Barnet was male Twi'lek mercenary who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

After the Battle of Yavin, Udo Barnet and his group of mercenaries were recruited by the Galactic Empire to ensure the security of a secret Imperial research facility on the planet Lok. The mercenaries were led by Udo Barnet and Kell Lapaz,

In 1 ABY, As the criminals were planning their operation, Grenz Zittoun, another lieutenant of Nym, realized that the attack on the facility could be an unique opportunity to get rid of some annoying mercenaries. A group of spacers affiliated with the Lok Revenants then assaulted the research facility. They had to fight numerous mercenaries to get access to the research complex but they finally retrieved experimental weapons and research data. During the battle, a group of Revenants attacked Kell Lapaz and Udo Barnet and killed them in the ensuring firefight.

Udo Barnet was a non-player character in the 2003 video game Star Wars Galaxies, a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by Sony Online Entertainment and published by LucasArts, Udo Barnet was added to the game as part of the revamped "Nym's Theme Park,"
